verdict.rationale: Orama provides AnswerSession/ChatGPT-like Q&A features and an MCP server letting AI interfaces (ChatGPT, Cursor) query the data, which supports natural-language interaction with the search index. However, this is about querying data via NL, not operating the whole product (indexing, configuration, admin tasks) via natural-language commands. Missing for 10: evidence of full product control (schema creation, plugin config, deployment) via natural language, independent/hands-on validation of the AnswerSession or MCP NL experience, and any agentic command execution beyond Q&A retrieval.
